summary: Technitium DNS Server is an authoritative and recursive Domain Name System server that includes built-in ad blocking capabilities. It allows you to host your own DNS infrastructure and resolve network queries locally while filtering unwanted domains. The application is written in C# and is distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want fine-grained control over their local network's DNS resolution and require an integrated ad-blocking solution without managing a separate DNS sinkhole.
watchOut: Running your own recursive and authoritative DNS server introduces operational complexity if misconfigured, as network-wide internet access depends on its uptime and correct setup.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically handled via Docker containers, requiring persistent storage for configuration data and logs. You will need to ensure port 53 is correctly mapped and avoid conflicts with host-level DNS resolvers.
